table_title: CONTENTS, IN ACRE-FEET, AT 1600, WATER YEAR OCTOBER 1969 TO SEPTEMBER 1970
site_name: SLY CREEK RESERVOIR NEAR STRAWBERRY VALLEY, CALIF.
location_text: Lat 39°35'01", long 121°06'45", in NW¼NW¼ sec.20, T.20 N., R.8 E., Butte County, Plumas National Forest, on right bank 100 ft upstream from dam on Lost Creek, 1.4 miles northwest of Strawberry Valley.
quantities_units: contents (acre-feet); elevation at end of month (feet); change in contents (acre-feet)
notes: Table 2 on the page is the daily contents table (table 1 is the capacity table). Period of record (November 1961 to current year) and 'storage began in November 1961' are not the table's years.
